Filtering by system name will include all settings that have that system name or have no system name (null),

Get a system setting by ID or name. Note that setting names are not unique if there are multiple systems.

post.summary: Import a resource from an HRB package file.
post.description: Imports a resource from an HRB package file. The file should be uploaded as a form file named 'HrbPackageFile'. The details of the resource to be imported should be provided in the request body. Set IsRemoteWrappedDriver to true to setup the driver using RemoteDriverWrapper. In that case, RemoteIpAddress, RemotePort, DeviceIpAddress and DevicePort are used. Set IsDriverHostDriver to true to setup the driver using DriverHostRelay. In that case DriverHostApiUrl and DriverHostClientSecret are used. IsDriverHostDriver takes precedence over IsRemoteWrappedDriver. If neither are true, then the driver is setup locally.

get.summary: Fetch current Sample Operations for Order
get.description: This endpoint returns the current/active SampleOperations for the specified Order. Each plate in an order, also known as a "sample", has many operations according to the protocol steps. In a live order, these operations are called SampleOperations. This endpoint returns only the current SampleOperation for each plate. The SampleOperation might be finished, started, failed, etc.

delete.description: This will only cancel a queued request. If the device operation is already executing, it will not be canceled. Use Abort to cancel an active operation.

post.description:
The request will execute immediately if the system is Uninitialized, Paused or In Error and the device driver is not busy.
The request will be queued if the system is Initialized or Running and the Resource is claimed in an Order.
An Abort request will always execute immediately, and it will clear any other queued request for the Resource.
Only one request per Resource can be queued at a time. Subsequent requests for that Resource will return a validation error.
Initialize requests will attempt to Connect first if needed. ExecuteOperation requests will attempt to Connect and Initialize first if needed.
While a request is executing, the Resource will be Disabled so that it cannot be claimed in an Order. It will be re-enabled when the request is finished.
The response includes a RequestId that can be used to fetch the status of the request using GET /operations/{id}.
Note that Simulate, Unsimulate, Enable and Disable are executed immediately and do not return a valid RequestId.
This is an internal API

Start an inventory scan for an Order or Resource. Use the returned request ID to fetch the status of the scan. Partial scans for a resource require a list of ScanPositions. Note, PersistInventory is ignored and will be removed in the future.
